actions.idle: standing in a fighting stance, breathing, ready. A seamless loop
actions.walk: walking forward, a seamless walk cycle
actions.fall: falling through the air, arms out, a loop
actions.shield: guarding behind a glowing energy shield, holding it
actions.ledge: hanging from a ledge by the hands
actions.dizzy: dazed and wobbling on the spot, a loop
actions.helpless: tumbling down out of control, a loop
actions.hurt: knocked back by a hit, reeling, a loop
actions.land: landing from a jump with a small crouch
actions.dodge: a quick sidestep dodge on the spot
actions.airdodge: a quick twisting dodge in midair
actions.dtilt: a low sweeping strike along the ground
actions.fsmash: winding up, then a huge forward smash
actions.usmash: winding up, then a huge upward smash
actions.dsmash: a powerful low strike to both sides
actions.bair: a strike backward behind them in midair
actions.uair: a strike upward above their head in midair
actions.dair: a stomping strike downward in midair
actions.upb: a rising special move that launches them upward
